preRace.headline: Navesink.
preRace.subhead: Know the course. Run your race.
preRace.deck: A confirmed-race starter record for the Navesink Challenge 12K, ready for course-map review and Aaron's post-Chicago target.
preRace.goalA: Set the race purpose and target after the current race block is reviewed.
preRace.goalB: Run progressively, keep mechanics organized and compete intelligently over the final third.
preRace.goalC: Finish healthy and protect the next training block.
preRace.outlook: Registration is confirmed for the Navesink Challenge 12K. The authoritative race source does not yet record Aaron's goal, priority or planned shoe, so this remains a logistics-backed starter rather than a final performance prescription.
preRace.guardrails: Pain that changes gait, sharp or escalating symptoms, illness, dizziness or an abnormal warm-up response override pace, power, cadence and competitive goals.
preRace.courseSummary: The official event is a 12K road race based at Bodman Park. The organizer posts a 2026 course map and enforces a strict 1:55 course limit, with roads reopening at noon. Elevation and turn-specific execution still require course-map review.
preRace.weather: Add the final forecast 24–48 hours before the start. Adjust pace expectations before changing safe effort.
preRace.fieldRead: No verified entry-list analysis has been added. Treat any participant list as a dated snapshot and race the athletes who actually start.
preRace.strategySummary: Build from control to commitment. Verified terrain and conditions may change pace; effort and organized mechanics govern the plan.

strategy.cue: Let the race establish itself before committing.
Settle into economical rhythm and take free speed.
Stay patient through terrain and make clean passes.
Compete directly and finish with mechanics, not strain.

preRace.readinessGreen: Normal gait and stairs, ordinary soreness only, stable energy and a warm-up that improves movement: race the supported plan.
preRace.readinessYellow: Heavy legs, incomplete recovery or mild tightness with normal gait: reduce the target, extend the warm-up and reassess.
preRace.readinessRed: Sharp or increasing pain, gait change, illness, dizziness, abnormal fatigue or worsening symptoms: do not race hard.

logistics.item: Advance bib and shirt pickup at Birdsmouth Brewing.
Advance pickup at the M.Y.A.A. Little League Field clubhouse.
Race-day pickup at the M.Y.A.A. clubhouse.

preRace.bibPickup: Fri Nov 27, 4:30–7:30 PM at Birdsmouth Brewing; Sat Nov 28, 1–4 PM at the M.Y.A.A. clubhouse; or race day 8–9:50 AM at the clubhouse.
preRace.parking: Follow the organizer's 2026 parking guidance for Bodman Park and the M.Y.A.A. clubhouse.
preRace.arrival: Target 9:00 AM; arrive earlier if using race-day pickup.
preRace.warmup: Easy running, mobility, activation and short progressive strides; finish warm, not tired.
preRace.fuel: Use the familiar pre-race meal and optional practiced pre-start carbohydrate. In-race fuel is optional only if already practiced for this duration.
preRace.hydration: Arrive normally hydrated, use practiced sodium and fluid choices, and adjust quantity to verified weather rather than forcing a fixed volume.
preRace.equipmentNotes: Charge the watch, confirm data screens and auto-lap settings, pin the bib, and use only equipment already proven in training or racing.
